03 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS

A curious mind.
A maker at heart.

I’m Satvik Karnati, studying Game Art and Design at ICAT Design and Media. I explore how things look, how they feel and how people experience them — from a lantern-lit environment to a thoughtful digital interface.

My practice spans game art, UI/UX, branding, packaging and graphic design. I enjoy bringing a clear idea to life, then paying attention to the details that make it work.
